ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #17
====

GRADE: Grade 2
SUBJECT: ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Glucose and oxygen
   B. Only water vapour
   C. Only carbon dioxide
   D. Nitrogen gas only

2. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water removes heat too quickly
   B. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
   C. Petrol fires have no fuel
   D. Water always increases oxygen

3. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Weather its resources? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Weather its resources.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Weather its resources.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Weather its resources.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Weather its resources.

4. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Ice melting to water
   B. Iron rusting
   C. Paper burning to ash
   D. Milk souring

5. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Precautions when using? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Precautions when using.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Precautions when using.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Precautions when using.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Precautions when using.

6. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Interpreting? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Interpreting.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Interpreting.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Interpreting.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Interpreting.

7. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Energy: Light its resources? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Energy: Light its resources.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Energy: Light its resources.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Energy: Light its resources.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Energy: Light its resources.

8. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. Movement of water only across a membrane
   B. A chemical reaction forming ash
   C. Heating until a solid melts
   D. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration

9. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
   B. A compound can be separated by filtering only
   C. A mixture always has a fixed melting point
   D. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya

10. Which practice best shows correct science when studying School environment environment? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to School environment environment.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for School environment environment.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on School environment environment.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about School environment environment.

11. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Animals resources? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Animals resources.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Animals resources.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Animals resources.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Animals resources.

12. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Soil and its resources? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Soil and its resources.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Soil and its resources.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Soil and its resources.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Soil and its resources.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Caring for Animals environment and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Safety in handling and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Caring for water environment and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Re-using water and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
